intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: The Palace Court is dressed for a wedding. Every centerpiece wears a little label in the bride’s capitals: *NOT FOOD*.

intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: The bride herself is inspecting her bouquet, stem by stem.

intro.speaker: SENNA
intro.text: “Lily of the valley. Beautiful. Nobody let the palace cat near it.”

intro.speaker: PLAYER
intro.text: “Is the palace cat invited?”

intro.speaker: SENNA
intro.text: “The palace cat attends everything. It has never once been invited.”

intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: Doctor Dorrance rises to give a toast. He has written it on four cards and drops two of them.

intro.speaker: PHYSICIAN
intro.text: “When Her Highness arrived with four trunks of what I took to be weeds, I gave her a week.”

intro.speaker: PHYSICIAN
intro.text: “She has since corrected my herbal in forty-three places. In pencil. I have kept every…”

intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: He doesn’t finish. He sits down and cries into a napkin, and then into Pim’s sleeve.

intro.speaker: SENNA
intro.text: “He kept them. That’s why he stopped putting leeches on burnt thumbs.”

intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: Then come the vows. Senna’s are numbered. You recognize the format.

intro.speaker: SENNA
intro.text: “One. Some days I’ll sit down without sorting anything. Two. I’ll tell you when you’re wrong about plants. That’ll be often.”

intro.speaker: SENNA
intro.text: “Three. I’ll always tell you when you’re about to eat something you shouldn’t.”

intro.speaker: SENNA
intro.text: “Don’t eat that.”

intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: You put down the canapé. It has a sprig of holly on top. Its label says *NOT FOOD*.

intro.speaker: SENNA
intro.text: “Four. There were nine. I cut five for being sentimental. One of them rhymed.”

intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: Later, in the Royal Gardens, Senna kneels at the physic beds in her wedding dress, with her gardening gloves on over the sleeves.

intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: Beside the label with both your names on it, one small green leaf has come up through the soil.

intro.speaker: SENNA
intro.text: “That’s early. The literature says four months. It’s been six weeks.”

intro.speaker: PLAYER
intro.text: “Maybe it likes us.”

intro.speaker: SENNA
intro.text: “Don’t be sentimental about a hellebore. It isn’t.”

intro.speaker: SENNA
intro.text: “Nothing out here is sprained. I came anyway. I want you here. That’s different. I checked.”

intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: She leans over and rests her forehead against yours. Then she goes back to watching the leaf.

intro.speaker: SENNA
intro.text: “Vow three. Don’t eat it.”
